note.after_visit_summary: You have high blood pressure that is not yet under control, even though you are taking amlodipine. Your family history of heart disease and stroke increases your risk, so we need to lower your blood pressure further. We are increasing your amlodipine to 10 mg once daily and asking you to stop pseudoephedrine, which can raise blood pressure. Instead, use fluticasone nasal spray two sprays in each nostril once daily for your sinuses. Because you snore and your spouse has seen you stop breathing at night, we are ordering a home sleep study to check for sleep apnea, which can worsen blood pressure. We also want an ultrasound of your heart (echocardiogram), a cholesterol test, and a urine test to check for kidney effects. Please limit salt to less than 2000 mg per day and have no more than one or two beers at a time. Keep checking your blood pressure at home twice daily and bring the log and cuff to your next visit. If you ever have chest pain, sudden weakness, or trouble speaking, call 911 right away. We will see you back in 4 weeks to review your test results and home blood pressure readings.
